# A one-way prop read through a `#id` is what the call site gave it, on every
# target (passNodePropReads, propHolds): nothing but the call site writes
# a one-way prop, so `bar.text` is "b{n}" for as long as the button is
# rendered. It used to be left to each target to read off its widget, and none
# kept a getter: gtk4 read `m.bar.Text` off a cgo.Widget, bubbletea named a
# field its Model never declared, and fyne and html read a handle the inliner
# had spliced away inside a component.
#
# A two-way prop bound to a var holds the var (propHolds): `box.value` is `v`,
# which the binding keeps in step with what the user types. bound.sngl is
# that read; fyne had title-cased it onto an Entry that spells it Text. One
# left unbound is the instance's cell, which already answered.
#
# The test reads it a second way: `c.out.value` is "{bar.text}" read through
# the instance, and the `c.bar` that rebases to is an element ref the next
# round answers in turn.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin bound.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component reader ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #bar(text="b{n}", @click { n += 1 })
        ui.text #out(value="{bar.text}")
    }
}

ui.window {
    reader()
}

func testRead(t test.Test, c reader) {
    t.assert(c.out.value == "b0")
    t.assert(c.bar.text == "b0")
    c.bar.click()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "b1")
    t.assert(c.bar.text == "b1")
}
-- bound.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component form ui.node {
    var v = "x"
    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #box(:value=v)
        ui.text #out(value="{box.value}")
        ui.button #set(text="s", @click { v = "y" })
    }
}

ui.window {
    form()
}

func testRead(t test.Test, c form) {
    t.assert(c.out.value == "x")
    c.set.click()
    t.assert(c.out.value == "y")
}
